name: @causeway-services/equivo-service
description: Equivo is a public course on obstruction-measurement mathematics, built from its authored course material and the reusable education platform.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext themes/equivo/*.mts themes/equivo/registers/*.mts themes/equivo/test/*.test.mts web/test/*.test.mts
scripts.build:web: npm run build:world && npm run build:vendor
scripts.verify:web: npm run build:web && npm run test:web
